items.rationale: The model keeps nothing between calls; the program builds the full message list and sends it again with the new question. Picking a means believing the model remembers the chat by itself.

Call 1 is 2,000. Call 2 is 2,000 + 100 + 500 = 2,600. Call 3 is 2,600 + 100 + 500 = 3,200. Total 2,000 + 2,600 + 3,200 = 7,800. An answer of 3,200 counts only the last call; 2,000 x 3 = 6,000 forgets the history grows.

Retrieval keeps the big text outside and sends only the best few chunks, so each call carries a small part of the manual. Pasting the manual in every call (b, c) pays for 40,000 tokens each time, and the model does not keep it between calls; training data does not hold the team's own manual (d).
